original_issue: Synchronous writes to observation tables could delay a monetary statement until the application transaction deadline and cause rollback.
fix: Migration280 updates only fixed-size expected amount and revision fields in the original account row. The background observer reads those projections and writes aggregate revision ranges without locking or updating account rows.
audit_semantics: Aggregate account reconciliation, not a complete per-mutation audit journal. Per-request deduplication and intent evidence remain separate.
verified_boundary: Unavailable, locked or slow observation tables do not block the original monetary transaction. Ordinary business failures and a driver-initiated cancellation of an already expired transaction are not claimed to be recoverable.
